title: Sh, Ch, Th Worksheets | 1st Phonics Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: RF.1.3a, RF.1.4

Give your learners extra practice with Sh, Ch, Th! This no-prep printable pack has 6 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (9 pages)

  • Cover page
  • sh, ch or th?
  • Digraph Sort
  • Digraph Match
  • Missing sh, ch, th, wh
  • The Ship
  • Chip the Chick
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (sh, ch or th?, Digraph Sort, Digraph Match, Missing sh, ch, th, wh, The Ship, Chip the Chick), so children can play, then print and practice
